why: The page teardown disposes the HUD but not the Customize panel's live preview -- a SECOND WebGL context, hanging off an element the HUD owns. `route-ui.ts` documents this page's ceiling as 'peak is two live contexts, never three', and the panel can genuinely still be open at teardown because `boot.ts`'s `pagehide` can fire at any time. Invisible to everything except a disposal count: nothing about the answer, the screen or any later session changes. 1 of 18, 'disposes the HUD and the live preview, and only from here' -- whose other half (that a SESSION teardown disposes neither) is what moved in this issue.
